examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{雨量|うりょう}が{少|すく}ない。
{雨量|うりょう}{計|けい}で{降水量|こうすいりょう}を{測|はか}る。
examples.english: We measure precipitation with a rain gauge.

examples.japanese: {梅雨|つゆ}の{時期|じき}は{雨量|うりょう}が{増|ふ}え、{河川|かせん}の{水位|すいい}が{上昇|じょうしょう}する。
examples.english: During the rainy season, rainfall increases and river water levels rise.

notes:
Compound of {雨|う} (rain) and {量|りょう} (amount). Commonly used in weather reports, geography, and agriculture. Measured in millimeters (mm) in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨量|うりょう}{計|けい}: rain gauge
- {年間|ねんかん}{雨量|うりょう}: annual rainfall
- {総|そう}{雨量|うりょう}: total rainfall
- {雨量|うりょう}が{多|おお}い: heavy rainfall
- {雨量|うりょう}が{少|すく}ない: low rainfall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {降水量|こうすいりょう}: precipitation — more technical and scientific, includes rain, snow, and all forms of precipitation
- {降雨量|こうりょう}: rainfall amount — more formal synonym, used in technical reports
- {豪雨|ごうう}: heavy rain — refers to the intensity rather than measured amount
